A statement on Tuesday by the Chairman, Planning Committee, Olusegun O. Adekunle, Esq., noted that the colloquium, to be held at the Rotunda Conference Hall of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Abuja, is the flagship event of the two-day 2026 CORFEPS Week.
He said the event, themed “Navigating the Headwinds of Governance: Centrality of the Civil Service,” will provide a platform for serving and retired public service leaders, policymakers, development partners and other stakeholders to reflect on the challenges confronting governance and the measures required to strengthen the Nigerian civil service.
According to the statement, the immediate past Secretary to the Government of the Federation, Boss Mustapha, will deliver the lead paper, drawing on his extensive experience in public administration and governance.
“The paper will be further examined by a panel comprising Mrs Didi Esther Walson-Jack, immediate past Head of the Civil Service of the Federation; Dr (Mrs) Habiba Lawal, a retired Federal Permanent Secretary and pioneer Special Adviser to the President on Policy and Coordination; and Dr MacKalba Danjuma Usman, Permanent Secretary, Common Services Office, Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation.
“The session will be chaired by Senator Cyril Olawale Fasuyi, Chairman of the Senate Committee on Establishment and Public Service Matters.”
The statement further noted that discussions will focus on how the civil service can sustain its institutional permanence while strengthening impartiality, transparency, accountability, efficiency, productivity, integrity and citizen-centred service delivery as Nigeria navigates contemporary governance challenges and prepares for another political transition.
It said the colloquium will also feature the unveiling of the maiden edition of the CORFEPS Journal, marking another milestone in the Council’s commitment to promoting informed discourse on public administration, governance and national development.
“Expected at the event are members of the Federal Executive Council, serving and retired Federal Permanent Secretaries, heads of government agencies and commissions, captains of industry, members of the diplomatic community, development partners, civil and public servants, civil society organisations, non-governmental organisations and the media,” it said.
It said the National Chairman of CORFEPS, Mahmud Yayale Ahmed will welcome guests to the event, which is expected to attract distinguished public service figures, including Engr. Ebele Okeke, Nigeria’s first female Head of the Civil Service of the Federation, alongside other eminent serving and retired public officials.
